title: User Interface Module
summary: This module constitutes the entire web-based graphical user interface of the application, providing interactive components, managing application state, handling data flow, and integrating with backend services and the native host environment.

nodes.label: Core UI Components
nodes.title: Reusable UI Elements
nodes.description: Provides fundamental and reusable React components for rendering the application's user interface, including layouts, displays, and interactive elements.

nodes.label: UI Logic & State Hooks
nodes.title: Application Logic & State Management
nodes.description: Encapsulates complex UI logic, state management, and interactions through custom React hooks and context providers, managing chat, model, and streaming states.

nodes.label: Backend API Client
nodes.title: Backend API Communication
nodes.description: Handles all asynchronous communication with the application's backend API for data fetching, mutations, and service interactions.

nodes.label: Data Models & Routing
nodes.title: Data Structures & Navigation
nodes.description: Defines core data structures for API responses, manages application routing, handles session state, and provides utilities for file processing and global interface extensions.

nodes.label: Application Backend API
nodes.title: External Backend Service
nodes.description: The primary backend service that the user interface communicates with to perform operations, fetch data, and manage user sessions.

nodes.label: React Framework & State
nodes.title: React Core & Data Management
nodes.description: The foundational React library for building user interfaces, including core hooks and a data fetching/caching library for efficient state management.

nodes.label: Browser APIs
nodes.title: Web Browser Functionalities
nodes.description: Standard web browser APIs providing access to DOM manipulation, local storage, timers, and other client-side functionalities.

nodes.label: Webview Host Integration
nodes.title: Native Host Communication
nodes.description: The module responsible for integrating the web-based UI with the native desktop application host, enabling communication and native feature access.

groups.label: Presentation Layer
groups.title: Visual & Interactive UI
groups.description: This group encompasses all the visual and interactive elements that users directly engage with, forming the application's graphical interface.

groups.label: Logic & State Management
groups.title: Core UI Logic & Data Flow
groups.description: Manages the application's dynamic behavior, data flow, and state changes, leveraging React's capabilities and browser features.

groups.label: Data & API Integration
groups.title: Backend Communication & Data Handling
groups.description: Handles all communication with the backend services, defines data structures, and manages application-wide routing and data flow.

groups.label: Platform Integration
groups.title: Native Environment Bridge
groups.description: Facilitates seamless interaction between the web-based user interface and the underlying native desktop application environment.
